notes.title: ODD research notes system anchors
notes.summary: Seed note linking Typst ecosystem sources to ODD research notes UI and PDF workflows.
notes.content: Anchors for the ODD notes stack: bananote for research notes, scienceicons for visual cues, and book/report templates (may/bookly/owlbear) for structured exports. Use Typst template design guidance to keep notes reusable.
